_about: Starting DNAs for a new set. Pick the one closest to the product's feel, copy its dna, add a style from its styles list, then tune it on the candidate preview.

pixel.description: retro bitmap look: one stroke is one pixel, built only from horizontal and vertical runs
pixel.notes: sizes must be whole multiples of 12 (24px makes every icon pixel 2×2). minGap 0.4 only lets diagonal pixel contact count as a join; keep at least one empty pixel between separate parts by eye. Single pixels count as pieces, so medium detail still looks sparse.

plain.description: neutral, even-weight line icons that sit quietly in almost any interface

soft.description: light strokes with wide, smooth corners: warm and polished
soft.notes: Large corners eat into small shapes: below largeThreshold use the small radius, and skip rounding where three or more lines meet.

crisp.description: thin lines, hard corners and square ends: exact and technical
crisp.notes: Square caps reach half a stroke past each endpoint, so end lines 0.75 short of where the padding starts. Miter joins on sharp diagonals spike; keep diagonal corners at 90° or wider.
